title: Bento grid (Properties)
instructions:
Goal:

The 'Bento box' style design is a very popular web design element. It is a neat grid of boxes.

  • Wrap the (.bento-grid) to a grid.
  • We want to turn this into a 2x2 grid. Command the grid to have exactly 2 equally wide columns (ideally, use a repeat function to save yourself some coding).
  • Add a nice gap of 20px between all the grid boxes.
